shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- app/page.tsx ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && printf '\\n--- project page ---\\n' && sed -n '1,260p' 'app/projects/[slug]/page.tsx' && printf '\\n--- layout ---\\n' && sed -n '1,220p' app/layout.tsx && printf '\\n--- next docs candidates ---\\n' && find node_modules/next/dist/docs -type f | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app | rg '(link|loading|streaming|partial|prefetch)' && printf '\\n--- data files ---\\n' && rg --files | sed -n '1,100p' && printf '\\n--- lib data ---\\n' && sed -n '1,260p' lib/data.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/prefetching.md && printf '\\n--- link api ---\\n' && sed -n '1,250p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/link.md && printf '\\n--- loading ---\\n' && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/loading.md && printf '\\n--- streaming ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/streaming.md"

/bin/bash -lc "cat next.config.ts && printf '\\n--- partial prefetching guide ---\\n' && sed -n '1,280p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/adopting-partial-prefetching.md && printf '\\n--- optimizing prefetching ---\\n' && sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/optimizing-prefetching.md && printf '\\n--- cache components docs ---\\n' && rg -n \"'use cache'|Cache Components|params\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/caching.md | head -60"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"navigation\\(\\)|prefetch\\(\\)\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/optimizing-prefetching.md | head -100 && printf '\\n--- navigation function doc ---\\n' && sed -n '1,300p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/navigation.md && printf '\\n--- partial config doc ---\\n' && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/partialPrefetching.md && printf '\\n--- use cache guide files ---\\n' && rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app | rg 'cach|instant-navigation' | head -50"
